Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE PINOY UPATNA9AUUD* N0.æ S. OCT 12 VICE MAYOR PACIFICO C. VELASCO-OSL Bacarra, Ilocos Norte Dear Vice Mayor Velasco: This has reference to your IO October 2011 letter seeking the Departments legal opinion regarding the scope and coverage of Section 60 of the Local Government Code of 1991, specifically on whether elected government officials are covered by the said provision. In your letter, you stated that you were on sick leave from January 17, 2011 to present due to an operation that led to the removal of your gall bladder. Your application for sick leave was supported with medical certificate duly notarized. According to you, Mayor Nicomedes C. dela Cruz is trying to harass you by using Section 60 of the Local Government Code. Hence, your query. At the outset, please be informed that Sec. 60 of RA 7160 enumerates the grounds for an elective local official to be charged administratively. However, before you can be administratively charged, certain qualifying facts should be patent. As regards your supposed leave of absence, may we invite your attention to the pertinent provisions of law: Sec. 47 (a) (2) of the Local Government Code. — (a) Leaves Of "Section 47 Approval of Leaves of Absence absence of local elective officials shall be approved as follows: 411 xxx xxx xxx (2) Leaves of absence of a vice governor or a city or municipal vice mayor shall be approved by the local chief executive concerned." Rule XVI Sections 5, 53, 54 of Omnibus Rules Implementing Book V of Executive Order 292. "Sec. 5. Leave credits of local officials xxx xxx xxx

However, starting January 1, 1992, local elective officials shall be entitled to leave privileges as those enjoyed by the appointive local officials, including accumulation and commutation thereof" "Sec. 53. Application for sick leave. - All applications for sick leave of absence for one full day or more shall be made on the prescribed from and shall be filed immediately upon employee's return from such leave. Notice of absence, however, should be sent to the immediate supervisor and/or to the agency head, Application for sick leave in excess of five (5) successive days shall be accompanied by a proper medical certificate. Sick leave may be applied for in advance in cases where the official or employee will undergo medical examination or operation or advised to rest in view of ill health duly supported by a medical certificate. In ordinary application for sick leave already taken not exceeding five days, the head of department or agency concerned may duly determine whether or not granting of sick leave is proper under the circumstances. In case of doubt, a medical certificate may be required. "Sec. 54. Approval of sick leave. - Sick leave shall be granted only on account of sickness or disability on the part of the employee concerned or of any member of his immediate family. Based on Section 47 (a) (2) of the Local Government Code, the approving authority of your leave of absence, is your local chief executive. With regard to your application for sick leave, it shall be made on the prescribed form and be filed immediately upon your return from leave. Notice of absence, however, should be sent to your local chief executive. Or you may apply for in advance because you undergo medical operation, and must be duly supported by a medical certificate. Thus, may we advise you to observe the proper procedure in the application of Sick leave Of absence. Hence, if you comply the above discussion on the proper filing of application of leave of absence, then any administrative charges to be filed against you would stand on watered grounds. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. ATTY.JE SB. DO UE IV Director Ill Cs/lß/rb-usbfolcür
